steps.content: Finally, you come to that phone booth again, where you got dragged into this entire crisis and eventually terminated it.
This place was once the center of Mania as well as a peaceful eye of the storm where people could take refuge.
Once again, you push the door open and walk into the phone booth, and the three worlds seem to overlap anew in that instant.
You pick up the phone. The receiver is only silent in your hand for a moment before a cacophony of voices pours into your mind again.

steps.speaker: Voice on the Phone
steps.content: <color=#005aff>I'm starting to miss you. Will you come to me? I'd like to hear your voice.</color>

steps.speaker: Voice on the Phone
steps.content: <color=#12edcb>Pleased to meet you in this place, at this moment.</color>

steps.speaker: Voice on the Phone
steps.content: <color=#ff0093>It's okay, we've found it... the voice I want most...</color>

steps.speaker: Voice on the Phone
steps.content: <color=#005aff>People often feel anxious, becoming irritable and wanting to vent.</color>

steps.speaker: Voice on the Phone
steps.content: <color=#12edcb>But the voice in my heart was telling me... that wasn't what I wanted.</color>

steps.speaker: Voice on the Phone
steps.content: <color=#ff0093>Call me by my name, please. Call me... Eleven.</color>

steps.speaker: Voice on the Phone
steps.content: <color=#12edcb>I, we... will always be with you.</color>

steps.speaker: Voice on the Phone
steps.content: <color=#ff0093>You've got a nice voice too, one that makes your listeners happy.</color>
But in the end, you hear something shatter crisply. Just like those shattered worlds, only the busy tone remains afterward, snapping you out of the absurdity and bringing you back to reality.
You place your hand on the phone, but end up not picking it up after hesitating briefly.
You may have a thousand things to say now, but you want to express your heartfelt feelings to that person face-to-face.
